parameters.responseBody:
={
  "session_id": "{{ $json.session_id }}",
  "status": "{{ $json.decision === 'approve' ? 'approved' : $json.decision === 'reject' ? 'rejected' : 'modification_requested' }}",
  "next": "{{ $json.decision === 'approve' ? 'agents_dispatched' : 'terminated' }}",
  "goal": "{{ $json.goal }}",
  "tasks": {{ JSON.stringify($json.tasks || []) }},
  "message": "{{ $json.decision === 'approve' ? 'Session approved — agents dispatched.' : $json.decision === 'reject' ? 'Session rejected.' : 'Modification requested.' }}"
}
